name: Cristalli di ghiaccio
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: a single finished transparent reward illustration for PREVEDIApp, matching its Terra botanical wellness website.
Scene/backdrop: genuine transparent alpha around the entire isolated subject, no landscape, no background fill, no circle or badge.
Style/medium: warm botanical storybook gouache illustration with simple rounded organic silhouettes, confident smooth dark earthy-brown outlines, restrained soft flat shading, matte colors, a very light hand-painted texture. Match a friendly illustrated pinecone mascot and the site's botanical potted-plant illustrations. The result must look like a member of one consistent illustration family, never a realistic object or a 3D render.
Color palette: leaf green #4A7C59, sage green, earthy brown #6B6358 outlines, muted honey ochre #C4A66A, warm ivory #F5F4EF; winter accents only muted dusty pale blue #A8C6CC. Keep saturation calm and natural.
Composition/framing: square canvas, one centered compact subject group filling about 78 percent of the canvas with balanced transparent padding on all four sides; complete silhouette, broad recognizable forms readable at 80 px. Consistent medium outline weight, simple details, no excessively tiny decoration.
Mood: gentle, familiar, calm and welcoming, softly shaded with no dramatic lighting.
Constraints: no text, letters, numerals, logo, watermark, interface, border, frame, solid background, painted checkerboard, photorealism, 3D plastic, glassy gloss, cinematic depth of field, sparkly lens effects or long cast shadows. Objects have no faces; only the explicitly requested animal may have a friendly face. Generate one illustration, not a sheet or grid.
Subject: A small compact cluster of three rounded faceted ice crystals in pale dusty blue and warm ivory, with subtle sage reflected tones. One taller central crystal and two smaller side crystals, gentle brown-gray outlines, simplified flat translucent-looking facets. No jewelry, gem colors, sharp spiky fantasy crystal or reflective 3D render.
transformation: Mechanical resize to 640x640 and WebP encoding at quality 88; alpha preserved, no artistic post-processing.
